blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A shear line and the northeast monsoon, or amihan, are expected to bring cloudy skies and rain to parts of Luzon on Wednesday, according to the state weather bureau. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the shear line will bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over Aurora, Quezon, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, Marinduque and Oriental Mindoro. Meanwhile, the northeast monsoon or amihan will bring similar weather conditions over Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela and Apayao.
